title: Dynamic Menu-Based Pricing for Electric Vehicle Charging with Vehicle-to-Grid Integration
summary: The number of electric vehicles is rapidly increasing worldwide. This growth brings significant environmental benefits but also introduces new challenges: uncoordinated charging can place stress on the grid, particularly during peak hours. Beyond these challenges lies the opportunity for electric vehicles to feed energy back to the grid (V2G), which helps balance supply and demand and supports renewable energy. However, current pricing schemes such as time-of-use tariffs provide little incentive for discharging. To study incentive design in a realistic context, we focus on a parking lot…
